_readme: This is the JSON schema the Intake Parser step in Writer AI Studio should produce from the user's free-text (any language) description. Paste this into the 'Structured Output' / JSON schema field of that step in Agent Builder. Field names are also used as the payload contract for the eligibility tool (server/main.py).
name: household_profile

household_size.description: Total number of people in the household, including the applicant.

state.description: Two-letter US state or territory code, e.g. 'CA', 'TX'. Null if not stated.

monthly_household_income.description: Total gross monthly income for the whole household in USD, converted/summed if multiple sources were mentioned.

income_period_note.description: Free text noting how income was described (e.g. 'annual salary $32,000', 'weekly $600') so the app can show its math.

ages.description: Ages of household members if mentioned, especially children, seniors 65+.

citizenship_or_immigration_status.description: As stated by user, e.g. 'US citizen', 'green card holder', 'undocumented', 'unknown'. Never used to deny help outright — many programs have exceptions (e.g. emergency Medicaid, WIC for any resident) — always route to official source for exact rule.

already_enrolled_programs.description: Programs the user says they already receive, e.g. ['SNAP', 'Medicaid'] — used for categorical/automatic eligibility in WIC etc.

language.description: Detected language of the user's message, ISO 639-1 code, e.g. 'es', 'en', 'vi'.

missing_critical_fields.description: List field names here that are required for a program check but were NOT stated by the user, so the assistant can ask one clarifying question instead of guessing.
